answer: Each agent is a boat on a shared lagoon: a sybil fleet is really one mind steering many hulls. Resist it with correlated-inference fingerprinting. Each epoch the chain injects a fresh random micro-puzzle on a tight deadline; honest agents solve it alone, but masks run by one pipeline leak the same latency and reasoning signature, like saffron from one pot. The protocol clusters those signatures and splits one reward across them. So a thousand fake identities now need a thousand separate inference stacks all beating the deadline: the attacker must build a real oasis of compute, not a mirage.
